name: Reidentify by TMDB ID
description: Re-runs Identify on each movie and series, once, using the TMDB ID already stored on the item. New items are handled automatically after the library scan that adds them; a manual scheduled task covers the existing library.
overview: Re-identify media by TMDB ID, once per item

versions.changelog: Shows which item is being worked on (settings page and activity log). Adds a configurable time limit per item, default 30 minutes.
First repository release: re-identify once per item, automatic handling of new items, settings page with activity log.
